summary: End-to-end test of Rantau — Malaysian Student Resource Hub. Backend (5/5 pytest passing): GET /api/ health, POST /api/upload (PNG happy path), GET /api/files/{path} returning image bytes with image/png, upload of text/plain returns 415, download of unknown path returns 404. Frontend flows exercised against production URL (Firebase Auth + Firestore): public browsing, seeded resources (13 total, 9 Administrative, 2 for tag 'caf'), 10 city cards, empty states, protected /events/new redirect to /login, signup+login of a fresh user, profile view and course edit persistence, event create → RSVP toggle Going 0->1->0->1, save event (appears under Profile → Saved events tab), comment post, Google Maps link present, resource submission with external link showing pending-badge to owner and hidden after logout, upvote 0->1, toggle off ->0, downvote ->-1, download counter incremented on resource-open click, community post create+delete, board filter by Housing category + Paris city, city hub Toulouse: suggest a place + add tip both work, dark mode toggle adds/removes html.dark class, mobile 390px hamburger opens nav-mobile-menu.

issues: Horizontal overflow detected: documentElement.scrollWidth > clientWidth on /  and /resources at 390px viewport. /events is fine. Likely a wide grid/card/pill not wrapped or a fixed-width image container.

Uncaught pageerror 'Cannot read properties of null (reading split)' fired during the transient state where firebase auth resolves before the Firestore users/{uid} doc is loaded. Root cause likely lib/format.js:initials(name) called with null user.name in navbar avatar. Add null-guard: name?.split(' ') or default to '' before split.
Console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — hydration warning from Signup year select markup (Year N label rendered with a span inside <option>).

action_items: Add null-guard in lib/format.js initials() (or wherever navbar reads user name) to avoid the transient 'Cannot read properties of null (reading split)' during signup.
Fix Signup year <option> markup to not wrap label text in a <span> to remove hydration warning.
Investigate and fix horizontal overflow at 390px on / and /resources pages (likely a card row not min-w-0 or an SVG/img without max-w-full).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py upload endpoint has TODO to verify Firebase ID token — currently anyone can upload as anyone (uid is a plain form field). Recommend integrating firebase-admin verify_id_token before accepting uploads.
Firestore is deliberately in open test-mode — must be tightened before production (called out by main agent but re-flag).
Mongo 'files' collection stores upload metadata but MongoDB _id is safely excluded from responses; good.
Frontend directly uses Firebase SDK — good, but ensure Firestore security rules enforce owner-only writes on votes/comments/posts before shipping.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested user-visible flows (minor design/console issues only)

seed_data_creation: Created via UI on live Firestore (project rantau-d7242): 1 event (Toulouse, id jVVNujRHMAeLcbKAXPnB) with 1 RSVP + 1 comment + saved by owner; 1 pending resource (external link https://example.com); 1 community post (created + deleted); 1 place (QA Nasi Lemak, Halal restaurant, Toulouse); 1 tip in Toulouse. Data left behind: event, resource, place, tip (post deleted). Main agent should clean up or leave as demo data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_rantau_backend.py; run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Frontend flows all passed on live app. Selects use option values with proper case: cities use display names ('Toulouse','Paris' etc.), year uses '1'..'6', event category is lowercase ('cultural','academic','social','sports'), resource category lowercase ('administrative','academic','living','community'), post category lowercase ('housing','marketplace','study_group','general','jobs'). Firestore long-poll makes wait_until='networkidle' hang — always use wait_until='load' plus explicit wait_for_timeout.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — no blocking bugs. Only minor design/console issues documented above with root causes and suggested fixes.
